candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in your AI Engineering team. Building AI prototypes and testing their reliability and output quality is what my latest project is about, and I would like to help take such prototypes towards production.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I also bring industry experience in data preparation and validation on SAP platforms.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I designed DocuMind's evaluation harness (hit rate, MRR, LLM judge, latency, cost) and shipped it with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker
in industry I prepared, validated and reconciled data with SQL and ABAP CDS views for dashboards used across HR, finance and supply chain

letter.problems_section: I would help implement AI applications on existing models and services, prepare data, build and test proofs of concept, and keep documentation clear. I have not used enterprise AI assistants or low-code AI platforms yet, and I am keen to learn them.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
